rows: Why are volcanoes where they are?
Plate boundaries (convergent arcs + divergent ridges) + hotspots
Why is this valley U-shaped?
Glacial erosion (compare to V-shaped = fluvial)
Why is this soil fertile or poor?
CLORPT especially parent material + time + climate
Why is there a desert here?
Rain shadow (orographic), cold upwelling current, continentality, or subtropical high pressure
Why are there sinkholes here?
Karst (limestone dissolution) — check for karst region
Why does this earthquake area have no volcanoes?
Transform boundary (San Andreas) — no magma generation
Why are tsunami warnings relevant far away?
Ocean travel speed; wave amplitude grows as water shallows
